dedupe_keys.name: us drinking water utility climate change projections and combined hazard index scores

description: US Drinking Water Utility Climate Change Projections and Combined Hazard Index Scores is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Zia Lyle, Constantine Samaras (Carnegie Mellon University). This dataset includes climate change hazard projections and combined climate hazard index values for 42,786 drinking water utilities accross the continental United States (US). Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
